findings.title: False unsquared outer-factor bound in the proof of the principal Lipschitz estimate
all_operative_hypotheses: real measurable f,f' with even extensions
b=if under z=e^(2i theta), x=cos theta; pure imaginary and reflection symmetric
a*,a'* are outer with positive origin values and |a|^2+|b|^2=1

decisive_evidence.type: analytic counterexample, with separate independent numerical corroboration

alternate_readings: Omitted squares explain the first display but do not validate the following false coefficient.
A triangle estimate with a corrected 1/2 coefficient is weaker than retaining the squared estimate.
counterevidence: The cited reference actually supplies a valid squared estimate.
Retaining the squared estimate and the paper's other Lipschitz dependencies gives a coefficient <=1.5422422668 eta^-3, rigorously <1.6 eta^-3.
Independent finite low-degree RHW computations did not contradict the algorithmic theorem.
findings.core_dependency: Page 32 outer factor -> b/a quotient -> Theorem 12 -> arctangent -> Theorem 1 Lipschitz constant
findings.repair: Use sqrt(delta^-2+delta^-4) rather than delta^-1+(1/2)delta^-2, then retain the joint square-root factor throughout the constant estimate.
findings.impact_boundary: The two intermediate estimates are false. The advertised 1.6 eta^-3 final constant is recovered by the explicit repair. No false final theorem, failed existence/uniqueness result, or whole-paper failure is established.
findings.correction_search: Bounded primary author/journal exact-title correction searches retained under web_checks; no relevant correction located, not an exhaustive absence claim.

independent_verification.source_claim: Physical page 32, Section 4.5, after (98): the unsquared outer-factor inequality attributed to [1,(8.5)], and its following coefficient delta^-1+delta^-2/2.
independent_verification.hypothesis_check: The arc data with p=r=t=1/10,1/100,1/100 respectively have 0<eta=1-sqrt(1-r^2)<1/2; b=icq and bprime=icprime q correspond to real measurable even interval functions in S_eta. Their logarithms are bounded. The factors exp(log(r)(q-iHq)) and exp((log(r)+t)(q-iHq)) are precisely the positively normalized outer construction in Theorem 4, not arbitrary phase choices.
independent_verification.independent_proof_check: Re-derived the circle-measure normalization and the Hilbert-transform moment argument. On the arc, monotonicity of sin(u)/u gives integral_E h^2<=p/3; the log-ratio integral is pi^2/3. Hilbert isometry yields integral_Ec h^2>=p(2/3-p). The mean-zero analytic function q-p+ih has fourth mean zero, hence integral h^4<=6p. The global cosine bound then gives ||a-aprime||^2>=t^2 p(2/3-p-t^2/2). Both asserted right sides are strictly below the resulting 0.0075 sqrt(p). This proof is independent of numerical quadrature.

new_exact_rational_calculation.method: New exact rational arithmetic by independent acceptance executor; no author code and no rerun of prior quadrature

independent_verification.counterevidence_and_repair: Actually read and visually inspected source p32 and AMT reference p30: (8.5) has squared norms. Its cosine/Hilbert proof works for the present positive gap without the small-signal hypothesis used only in the subsequent reference estimate. Taking a square root gives sqrt(delta^-2+delta^-4). Combining the quotient identity, Theorem 12 and the 1-Lipschitz arctangent gives sqrt(2)delta^-6(1+delta)(delta^3+sqrt(1+delta^2)). Every factor increases for delta>0; delta<sqrt(3)/2 and exact rational upper bounds verify the final constant <1.55<1.6. The advertised theorem constant therefore survives this repair, conditional on its other dependencies.
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: The false estimates occur in the quantitative derivation of principal Theorem 1. Missing squares alone do not explain away the second false coefficient. Major is retained for an invalid core derivation under the operative calibration, without claiming whole-paper failure, false existence/uniqueness, or failure of the separate algorithm theorem.
independent_verification.limits: Only arXiv v3 dated 2026-03-04 was adjudicated. No journal VoR equivalence or global absence of corrections is asserted. Prior quadrature and finite RHW tests remain historical corroboration; no author code was executed and no redundant whole-paper review was performed.
